messages.body_plain:

messages.subject: Re: Shortcut Data view
messages.body_plain:
Hi Christian,

you can create an R Code Snippet with:

 > statet.openInEditor(${r_object_name})

and assign a keyboard binding to the snippet.

An alternative with using the mouse but without going over the object 
browser: the information hover in the R editor (with str information) 
also has a button for the data viewer.

Regards,
Stephan

messages.subject: Re: StatET on macOS mojave
messages.body_plain:
I have been unable to get rj working in R 3.5.1 since the Mojave update.
There are issues with needing fopenmp that seem unresolved.  Also, if you
are using Java 10 or later (the latest is 11), javah has been removed so it
has issues with that as well.

Will we see an update for rj anytime soon, or has it fallen out of
development?

--j
